title: Average track length
statementMd:
Average track length in seconds, rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `avg_seconds`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(AVG(seconds), 1) AS avg_seconds FROM tracks;
```
